claims.assertion: Anéeka says DNA encodes individual and past-life memory, with latent genes activated by expanded consciousness regardless of bodily location.
claims.speaker: Anéeka
claims.qualifiers: She says DNA changes accompany consciousness awakening.

claims.assertion: Anéeka says humans were not laboratory-created but comprise nested lineages of 22 races, with invasive genetic alterations reverting over generations without mind control.
claims.speaker: Anéeka
claims.qualifiers: She describes the 22-race figure as a simplified account of a much larger nested ancestry.
